product.description: Monoprice™Motorized Electric Above Fireplace Height-Adjustable Full-Motion TV Wall MountMotorized Above Fireplace Mantel TV Wall Mount for Most Flat or Curved Medium to Large 37" to 80" ScreensMany customers choose to mount their TV over a fireplace mantel due to the convenient and central room location. The Monoprice Motorized Above Fireplace Mantel Height-Adjustable TV Wall Mount offers a solid and affordable choice for over the mantel TV mounting options. Having the ability to adjust the height and depth of the TV for viewing and later retracting it back above the mantel when not in use provides a cleaner look and more efficient use of living space for the homeowner. A quiet motorized mechanism provides long life with smooth positioning and motion. Using the included remote, viewers can control the mounted TV from across the room.Powerful height-adjusting motorProgrammable position memoryRemote control includedArticulating level rotation and swivel designFits VESA® patterns from 200x100 to 600x400Designed for 37" to 80" displaysSupports up to 77 lbs.Fits flat or curved screens POWERFUL HEIGHT-ADJUSTING MOTORThis Monoprice Motorized Above Fireplace Mantel TV Wall Mount boasts a stable, strong, and durable electric motor allowing for fast positioning and motion. PROGRAMMABLE REMOTE CONTROL POSITION MEMORYWith the included remote control, you can record any comfortable position you like, and return to it whenever you need. ARTICULATING LEVEL ROTATION AND SWIVEL DESIGNThe articulating design of this motorized fireplace mantel TV mount helps to provide the ideal viewing position. This mount offers a swivel range of ±25° and a rotation range of ±3°. "IS THIS MOUNT COMPATIBLE WITH MY TV?"Check your TV's manual for its VESA mounting pattern, or vertical and horizontal distances between the mounting holes (in mm). This mount supports VESA patterns from 200x100 to 600x400 and supports TVs weighing up to 77 pounds. The screen size range is only a suggested approximation. Your TV is compatible as long as its VESA mounting pattern is between 200x100 to 600x400 and weighs no more than 77 pounds. STATE-OF-THE-ART STEEL CONSTRUCTIONThe Monoprice Above Fireplace Mantel TV wall mount is constructed from high quality, cold-rolled steel which gives the mount a strong, heavy-duty build, capable of supporting up to 77 pounds. Its new design also features a lighter build compared to older TV mounts. This mount can be easily mounted to brick, concrete, or wood stud walls.   .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}Lifetime WarrantyWith Monoprice's Lifetime Warranty, you can rest assured we stand behind our products and our customers.
